verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers SDKs for purchasing, entitlements, webhooks, paywalls, and web billing integration, but nowhere mentions a hosted customer portal or embeddable self-service components that let end users upgrade/downgrade/cancel without a support ticket. Community threads even flag friction moving subscriptions between platforms, with no counter-evidence of a self-service portal. missing for 10: any documentation of a hosted subscription-management portal, embeddable upgrade/downgrade/cancel widgets, or self-service flow that avoids support tickets.
